meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以「小省导购员」人设协同五个智能体，依次做需求对接、脚本创作、数字人口播、动态画面和音画合成，产出 9:16 竖屏 MP4 带货视频，并把脚本、音频、画面、成品归档到知识库复用。
howto.when: 当你需要生成带货视频、产品推荐视频或价格对比视频时触发，购物咨询类视频需求也适用。会先核查知识库，同类商品直接调取已生成素材。

say.text: 帮我做一条性价比手机的带货短视频，60秒，抖音用
say.note: 先核查知识库，无素材则启动新创作

say.text: 对比京东和淘宝同款 Nike 男鞋价格，做一条45秒视频
say.note: 产出分屏价格对比带货视频

say.text: 618大促推荐三款爆款家电，做一条90秒促销视频
say.note: 可调取同类素材框架改为促销信息

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs five agents under a shopping-guide persona: demand intake, scriptwriting, avatar voiceover, dynamic visuals, and audio-video mixing. It outputs a 9:16 MP4 product video and archives assets to the knowledge base.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a product-promotion video, product recommendation video, or price-comparison video; shopping-consultation videos also qualify. It checks the knowledge base first.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second Douyin product video for budget phones
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base first, then writes the script

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao in a 45s video
say_en.note: Outputs a split-screen price comparison video

say_en.text: Recommend three hot home appliances for the 618 sale in a 90s video
